project_type: Full-stack monorepo: Expo React Native mobile + Express.js backend + Vite React admin
build_system: Expo for mobile, Node.js for backend, Vite for admin. No Makefile.
test_framework: No test framework configured in any package
build_command: N/A - INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network, cannot npm install
verification_instructions: AST-level validation only: TypeScript must parse without errors. Use `npx tsc --noEmit` if available, otherwise validate imports/exports consistency manually.
setup_instructions: Cannot install dependencies due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot npm install, cannot pull Docker images, cannot access external registries. Must work with existing node_modules only. Validation is code-level/AST only.
contribution_requirements: Commit directly to fix/final-stabilization branch. Separate commits per logical change.

key_patterns.navigation: RootNavigator conditionally shows OnboardingScreen -> AuthStack -> AppStack based on Redux state (hasCompletedOnboarding, isAuthenticated, isGuest)
key_patterns.state_management: Redux Toolkit slices in mobile/src/store/slices/. appSlice manages onboarding state, authSlice manages auth state.
key_patterns.auth_flow: Google OAuth via @react-native-google-signin, backend authenticateWithGoogle returns {user, accessToken, refreshToken, isNewUser}
key_patterns.backend_api: Express routes in modules/ structure. PUT /users/me accepts role, subRoles, interests. GET /config/artwork-types returns active types.
key_patterns.username_generation: auth.service.js: baseUsername = name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ''), then append zero-padded suffix if duplicate exists
key_patterns.push_notifications: Mobile: expo-notifications -> registerForPushNotifications -> POST /users/me/push-token. Backend: expo-server-sdk -> sendPushNotifications batched to valid tokens.
key_patterns.admin_panel: Vite React app in admin/src/pages/. Users.tsx shows Avatar, Username, Email, Role, Sub-roles, 18+, Status, Actions.
key_patterns.cms_pages: CmsPageScreen accepts {slug, title}. Available slugs: terms-conditions, privacy-policy, creator-policy, copyright-policy.

directory_structure: monorepo with /backend (Express + MongoDB), /mobile (Expo React Native + Redux), /admin (Vite React + Tailwind)
